Hello, in #40737, i prove (as prerequisites of the definitions of K-sheaves) that some functors related with general topology are initials.

But for that i need to work in a file where general topology is imported but also the category theory part. The option i tried was to add this in Mathlib.Topology.Category.TopCat.OpenNhds but it turns out that this causes a large import.

I could'nt find a better file (either because no topology is imported or no category theory)
And the specific part is (i think) not enough to be a new file.

So my question is did i miss some file and if not what would be the standard way to solve this?

Thank you in advance
